description: Upware is the fastest way for non-technical people to build and deploy Copilot, GPT, and Claude agents and workflows across any system, in days instead of months. Our unique approach enables connecting your existing AI suite (Microsoft, OpenAI, etc.) to custom, homegrown, legacy, or 3rd party systems, without integrations, APIs, IT work, or hallucinations, and without yet another agent/workflow builder.
problem_statement:
- Enterprises want to use AI to streamline and automate processes
- The problem is most enterprise processes span across custom, homegrown, and legacy systems lacking APIs, with unique business logic, so AI integration that is process-adherent and hallucination-free becomes difficult, costly, and tech-led
- Most existing agentic/workflow solutions offer a standard API approach that doesn’t fit the enterprise stack, most automation solutions are brittle and standalone, forcing enterprises to buy, manage, and build in another tool, or require expensive engineering work (internal or external). This is why >70% of projects stall at POC
- Without a solution to build and deploy agentic workflows across these existing systems, the vast majority of enterprise AI potential will remain untapped

team.justification: The founding team has a strong blend of technical and business expertise. Tomer Suarez, the CEO, has a proven track record in building and scaling a company in a related field (RPA), and Rajan Chandra brings significant enterprise experience. The CTO, Eyal Avni, has a robust technical background with experience in high-growth tech environments.

company_assessment.market_positioning: Upware positions itself uniquely by embedding within existing AI ecosystems like Microsoft, which could provide a significant competitive advantage.
